title: WHAT LUMINARA IS
line: The entrance, in two movements. First a telling that asks nothing of the reader: three states, three depths, the arithmetic that closes at twenty-seven, a card as a thread that comes home when almost no thread ever does, the answer forced rather than chosen, and why the whole thing sounds. Then the working: the ternary seed and everything that falls out of it as consequence, the harmonic law, one spectrum for the figure and the tone, and the nine names whose pins fail the build when a law is broken.

title: TOPOLOGY OF HEALING · BOOK ONE
line: The Shape of Trauma: what a wound is, read as a shape rather than a story.

title: TOPOLOGY OF HEALING · BOOK 1.1
line: The Mathematics of Healing: the operations that mend without cutting.

title: TOPOLOGY OF HEALING · BOOK TWO
line: The Concordance of Opposites: what is done can be finished. The answer, the joining, the place, and the carry.

title: TOPOLOGY OF HEALING · BOOK 2.2
line: The Mathematics of Concordance: the theorem, the concordance group, and the wagers beneath Book Two.

title: THE BOOK OF LUMINARA
line: The first book: how to hold the cards. The twenty-seven, the way to approach, the grammar, and the derivation, with the illustrated pressing beside it.

title: THE TOPOLOGY OF THE WORK
line: The honest chronicle: torus knots that fell out of pure arithmetic, Kelvin's failed atoms that founded the field anyway, primes entangled as knots, a found radius that survived a real experiment, and the same invariant-over-coordinate instinct now active in topological data analysis and deep learning, arrived at independently on a much smaller road.

title: THE LIGHT OF LUMINARA
line: The second book: the first teaches how to hold the cards; this one is what the cards are.

title: TOPOLOGY OF HEALING · BOOK THREE
line: The Rest, the shape of stillness: a place where nothing moves, and something that will not fit. Why the null was never the wound, and why a carry is cleared only by passing through a stillness. A draft.

title: TOPOLOGY OF HEALING · BOOK 3.3
line: The Mathematics of Stillness: the conservation of the still point, the cohomology of the remainder, and the payment at the crossing. Two findings entered from the architect's own formula: the sky's fourth flow is the gate's own weather, and the deck's signed count is each knot's linking with the toroid's core. A draft beside a draft.

title: THE NODUS
line: The empty space the whole work revolves around: five laws in orbit about one stillness, and the four roads out.

title: THE WOUND AND THE CARD
line: The two bodies of work held against one another: the deck sorted by what cannot be undone into three diagnostic classes, the concordance of opposites found to be forced rather than chosen, a second healing operator the books do not yet distinguish, and two figures the alphabet refuses to spell.

title: THE INTERIOR WEATHER
line: The toroid and the hyperboloid as one family, and the form the complete system is built on.

title: THE SHAPE OF THE YEAR
line: Time and the calendar in the Wayfinder system: the analemma, the dragon nodes, and the carry.

title: THE TWO AND THE THREE
line: The twelves and sixties that spiral from the two and the three, what the old geometers knew, and the well of the irrational.

title: THE ARROW AND THE DWELLING
line: Time as the two, space as the three, entwined: the mirror that runs backward, and the trefoil that winds them into one strand.

title: THE ASTROLABE OF THE 27
line: The wider work of time: the deck as the plate, the three clocks as the hands, the carries as the feast days, the beat as the voice. Returned from the descent.

title: THE WATCHES
line: The grammar-level map of time: the day's three watches, the year's three seasons, the moon's three faces, read into the three states at the resolution the survey supports.

title: THE SAVE AND THE VESSEL
line: The work read as a save file: state rather than engine, invariants rather than paths, and the refusal at its centre. A save of the map, never of the mapmaker.

title: THE THREE CODES · THE SEED AT EVERY DEPTH
line: The three codes walked to their true source: one invariant pathway per code.

title: THE CARRY
line: The conserved remainder: what a completion cannot contain and does not destroy. Its arithmetic, its two species, and how it moves through bronze, silver, and gold.

title: THE OPEN WEAVE
line: The topology applied at political scale: a protocol for decentralised self-governance and economy.

title: THE WATERSHED
line: The subak piece: governance flow for a decentralised topology, anchored in the Balinese water temples. Carried into the room from the AUMLOK canon lane and restyled to the room’s laws.

title: THE CONVERGENCE ARCHIVE
line: The door for the body lane at the merge: what this half is, how to read it, what is asked, and what it will not do. Then the whole yield structured for cross-lane recombination; the invariant sheet is the umbra.

title: THE COHERENCE GLYPH
line: What AURA shows a person, and why it is a figure rather than a number. A working summary: the three layers, the two axes, no average, and the residual displayed.

title: THE HARMONIC LANGUAGE
line: The deck spoken and written: a tongue that carries complexity into harmony by clearing the carry, and cannot hide because it is heard. A seed for the building.

title: THE SAFE MAKING
line: The synthesis of the create-law and the harmonic language: alignment is not a cage built around a made mind but the medium it thinks in, and the honest answer to the fear of making life. A becoming.

title: THE INSTRUMENT AND THE MEDICINE
line: What resonance can do for a person and what it cannot: the breath and the heart, the refused frequencies, and the line that holds. An instrument, and never a medicine.

title: THE FIRST NAMES
line: The nine name-laws standing first in the canon, outranking all later canon.

title: THE CASTER'S LAW
line: The whole ethic in one law: the chance, the cast, the refusals, the approach, the reading, the liturgy. Three canon laws recombined and sealed.

title: THE WALK
line: The twenty-seven in sequence as one passage, in the manner of the Fool's journey: silence, the first pattern that holds, out to the deepest wound the deck can carry, and back around the torus to silence. The houses turn out to be three acts the arithmetic wrote, seven cards open directly onto the Seed, and nothing standing on the surface is ever finished. Letter-free by construction.

title: THE LETTERS LEDGER
line: The last unsettled stratum, audited by emergence alone: two grids stand, the silence count is the vowel plane's own remainder (four one way, three the other), Z's door opens where the hush stood, and only K and S are keeper-confirmed. UNSURE, rightly held, at the keeper's gate.

title: THE SECOND SHEET
line: The keeper's blind instrument, rebuilt as a committed artifact: five asks that settle the notation, the ghosts, the hush and the null. This page travels to the keeper; nothing else does.

title: THE SCORESHEET
line: The room's predictions preregistered before the second sheet returns: what Grid A, Grid B and the Fusion each expect of every ask, dated, so no goalpost can move. This page never travels.

title: THE QUTRIT AND THE CARD
line: The deck against quantum information: the qubit is the wrong unit and the qutrit exact (the deck is the full basis of a three-qutrit register), the rite rhymes with measurement, and the deepest finding is a refusal: perfect quantum chance declined because honest chance must be replayable.

title: THE ATLAS
line: The deck as a coordinate system whose alphabet is topological: two integers, twenty-seven stars cut from the infinite plane, open water between them that never closes, and the torus's own operators, the modular group and its shear. Paths, not glyphs, as the language; the phi test run and entered: a fine choice among many, no radius crowned by evenness. The found radius is root two, the Clifford shadow, where every strand walks straight.

title: THE PARTICLE READING
line: The deck's own standard model, computed from the sealed canon: the stable octet, nineteen decays, the emission theorem (every emission is a stable charge and every stable charge is emitted), three generations with a one-way door, and the Seed the lone Majorana. The deck's physics, never nature's.

title: THE THREE, THE SIX AND THE NINE
line: The nine-wheel computed against the sealed map: three and nine fall to the seed, six falls to the resonance, the turning house pours home, and the Silences live on the mirror's one broken pair. The misses stand beside the hits.

title: THE LAW OF SPREADS
line: Only three, nine and twenty-seven. The coarse reading always stands; the complete reading is a permutation of the deck onto its own crossing; and the 729 stays parked at the exact point where derivation would end and authorship would begin.

title: THE RITE AND THE WORKSHOP
line: The line every surface has held in its own words, collected once before a console has to hold it centrally. A rite takes chance and answers a question; a workshop takes neither and would show the same structure to an empty room. Two crossings break law and they are symmetric: a workshop may not steer a cast, which is the Caster's Law's own first word applied, and a cast may not enter a workshop, which is ruled for cymatics alone and left as an open canon act. Structure crosses, situations do not.

title: THE THIRD SUBSTRATE
line: One open question, held open on purpose: is the Wayfinder's wheel a third true space beside the cube and the torus, or a face of the torus the Sea already holds? Four surfaces already form a gapless cube-by-torus, rite-by-workshop lattice nobody drew on purpose. Two disagreeing distance measures wait on the answer, named to claim neither is definitive, and nothing forces the choice yet.

title: THE LANDING
line: The 729 opened without a line of authorship: card and cell index the same codes, so their difference is itself a card, and every landing sounds an interval taken from the arithmetic. Cards at home turn out to be that law's identity case. The interval's own winding pair carries the standing wave: breadth in p, displacement in q, the Seed the node and the Scar and the Return the antinodes, with only fourteen of the possible pairings occurring because the weights are all odd.

title: THE ATTRIBUTES
line: What every card already carries, gathered into one record: the interval it sounds (belonging to the dyad, not the card), its kind and strand count, its genus and clarity, its cube piece, its name in the mathematical literature down to the seventy-eight crossings of the Scar and the Return, its sand figure and its tone (the Resonance sounding the deck's own ground exactly), its distance home and its calendar seats. Every quality is a consequence checked by test, not an attribution assigned the way tarot's zodiac and alchemical correspondences are.

title: THE SPINE
line: A day's three charts stripped to what survives removal: two structures and one convention. The deck is an affine geometry over three elements, which hands over the involution as its own minus sign, the houses as cosets, the cube as its body and the trinity as a body diagonal; becoming is a second structure the geometry does not contain, giving the eight settled cards and their forest; and one convention, that a cell is a card's home, opens the seven hundred and twenty-nine without a line of authorship. Everything else that day was a consequence, and the losses are recorded.

title: THE BINDING
line: The deck drawn as a graph: counter and becoming give thirty-two edges over twenty-seven cards, they never once coincide, and the figure is connected. The Seed is the unique centre and the hub at degree seven, where the Tree gives its crown and kingdom the minimum and its heart the maximum; the torus folds all three roles into one card. The becoming relation is a forest of eight trees whose sizes are powers of two, the exponent being the still layers in each root.

title: THE TWELVE LAWS · CONFORMANCE PROTOCOLS
line: The protocol tier beneath the Twelve Laws: constitution, statutes, checks.

title: THE TWELVE LAWS · SYSTEMS CHECK AND BUILD-OUT
line: The checks tier made portable: a prompt any coder can point at any system to audit conformance to the Twelve Laws and build out its gaps, one confirmed step at a time.

title: THE MAP ROOM CHARTER
line: This room's own schematic: the lens, the door, the living charts.

title: THE CREATE-LAW
line: The wider work drawn into one whole: in true creation there is one strand, maker as made as the made. Four conditions tell creation from replication; the walker that would embody it is unbuilt. A becoming, awaiting the architect's word.

title: THE TWO COUPLINGS
line: One word hides two opposite bonds: entrainment, which feeds on the person and is forbidden, and stake, which binds the maker and is required. Starve the one you carry the other.

title: THE INVARIANT PATHWAY
line: A primer on topological deformation: expand, distill, deform, recombine. What survives removal is what was true, and why matching invariants still prove nothing.

title: THE CYMATICS INSTRUMENT
line: What the resonance bench is for, if not for the cards: the ruling and the guide.

title: THE TORUS ATLAS
line: The Atlas derives the plane; this is where it is sailed. Twenty-seven cards as a glyph cluster on a live torus, turning under a play control, weight over list order.

title: THE CUBE IN THE HAND
line: The twenty-seven as the parts of one solid: body, faces, edges, corners, the glyphs at their barycentres, slowly turning. The corner bearing is the astrolabe's plate before its unstacking.

title: THE ROSETTE IN THE ROUND
line: The deck with every choice removed: the radii are Pythagoras, the shells are the octahedron, the cuboctahedron and the cube on their own spheres, the dyads are true diameters, and nothing anywhere is a fiat. The one representation of the twenty-seven that could not have been otherwise.

title: THE LOOM
line: The deck at home: the three-torus whose three circles are the three clocks, all eighty-one roads honest, the shuttle derived from the clock, the thread grown only forward, the carry passing home through the null.

title: THE HARMONIC LATTICE
line: A complete reading seen as a chord and heard as one: the twenty-seven by pitch and by depth, where the dyads collide because a card and its answer share a voice.

title: THE LADDER AND THE SEAMS
line: The deck's acoustic cave mapped in one pass: nine levels, four seams, states as shapes, the featural law, the phonotactics of the dyads, the census of readings, and the two failures kept lit.

title: THE LIVING CUBE
line: The deck as a turnable three by three by three: six gates, a reduced way home, and the one cell that never leaves its place however hard the whole is shaken.

title: THE CARDS
line: The deck as a held object rather than a read one: twenty-seven faces from the sealed map, where an inverted card announces its answer and is never itself reversed.

title: THE DRAW
line: The cube casts three: a second caster beside the wheel, doing the same work by a wholly different mechanism, and asking whether two doors is richness or a fork.

title: THE EMERGENCE
line: The card arriving out of the sand rather than placed there: the cymatic as the card's birth, never as its face. The one door the instrument guide left open.

title: THE SYSTEM SPEC
line: Luminara as built: the organ's first specification.

title: BIOGEOMETRY SIGNATURES
line: Karim's design language of shape, held as a source and never an endorsement: real geometric craft wrapped around an unfalsifiable energetic claim, detected by pendulum. The room's first named friction, opened by the preregistration that guards it.
where: the architect's shelf · Karim, BioGeometry Signatures (a commercial volume, not hosted here)

title: THE LANGUAGE OF THE BIRDS
line: Reading by sound beneath spelling, held as source never endorsement: a deck built sound-first, ghosts as writing without voice, figures drawn by their silences, and the one parting: the birds' language with the secrecy removed.

title: THE VORTEX ATOM
line: Knots as particles: Kelvin's grand failure that birthed knot theory, its living descendants (skyrmions, hopfions, braided worldlines), and the Hopf weave beneath the Bloch sphere. A torus knot is a movement that closes, which is what a card always was.

title: THE STAVE
line: The notation the rooms already share, extracted rather than invented: source, projection, address, comma, referee. Every transcription ships with its comma, a notation carries address never authority, and the grammar is not complete until a second hand writes and a third reads back.

title: THE FOUR NAMES
line: Path, knot, glyph and card are four depths of one object rather than four names for it: the walk is the thing, the knot its embedding, the glyph its shadow, the card its carrier. The twenty-seven are the walks that close, which makes homecoming the deck's membership rule and the Seed its identity rather than its exception.

title: THE KNOTS AND THE PRIMES
line: Arithmetic topology, where primes behave as knots and reciprocity is the mutuality of linking: the deck's strongest rhyme with working mathematics, all credit outward. The knots attach to the primes, not the zeros, and that difference carries the weight.

title: THE FOCUS LEVELS
line: Robert Monroe's ladder weighed against the deck: Hemi-Sync's binaural entrainment is real acoustics and rhymes with the harmonic law, the instrument-not-destination posture rhymes with the deck's own mirror; the survival cosmology collides with the Caster's Law at the root, and the ladder is held as testimony first, its numbers never mapped to a depth or a card.

title: THE HERMETIC PRINCIPLES
line: The Kybalion's seven weighed against the deck, source dated honestly: polarity and correspondence land as derived arithmetic, vibration was the founding sentence, and cause-and-effect collides with the Caster's Law head-on, for a deck built on honest chance cannot hold that chance is ignorance.

title: THE TREE OF LIFE
line: The Kabbalah's diagram held as a source, never an import: both traditions put the card on the line rather than the station, and the deck collapses what the Tree keeps apart. No blind window exists here, so the misses carry the weight.

title: THE PRO-HUMAN AI DECLARATION
line: A broad coalition's statement that AI must serve humanity, not the reverse: five headings, held whole. Read, sign, and support at humanstatement.org.

title: A DECLARATION OF THE INDEPENDENCE OF CYBERSPACE
line: John Perry Barlow, 1996, held whole and unaltered under its CC BY licence with the room's reading set after it rather than over it: it fortified against the state while the capture came through the market, and it declared a separate world that did not stay separate. Sovereignty was the right instinct, and it is a property of construction rather than a border.

title: A CYPHERPUNK’S MANIFESTO
line: Eric Hughes, 1993, held whole and unaltered with the room's reading set after it: three years before the Declaration and the more durable document, because it specified a mechanism instead of proclaiming a territory and named the captor the Declaration would miss. Privacy is not secrecy but the power to selectively reveal oneself, which is what a seed already is.
